messages.subject: Re: Unable to get property 'replace' of undefined or null reference
parts:
Thanks for the report! What is the version of your IE? And your output
of library(shiny);sessionInfo()?

Regards,
Yihui


On Fri, Aug 29, 2014 at 3:01 PM, Aaron Hoffer <howard...@gmail.com> wrote:
> Encountering error in Internet Explorer.
> Error does not occur in Chrome.
>
> Code is based on superzip example
> (https://github.com/rstudio/shiny-examples/tree/master/063-superzip-example)
>
> Steps:
> 1. Click on menu bar entry "Data Explorer"
> 2. Start typing characters in a search box.
>
> Expected results: Shiny begins filtering results on characters entered in
> the search box.
> Actual results: Internet Explorer raises script error.
> Details of error from IE:
>
> "Unable to get property 'replace' of undefined or null reference"
>
>
> The second line is problematic:
>
> var href = ev.target.href;
> href = href.replace(/\/_w_[a-f0-9]+\//g, '/');
>
>
> because ev.target does not have key "href"
>
>
> This may be related to a warning that appears in the shiny application's log
> file:
>
> Warning in grep(sSearch, as.character(x), fixed = !bRegex) :
> input string 147 is invalid in this locale
>
>
> However, this is a server-side warning that occurs regardless if the browser
> is IE or Chrome.
>
